description: Open a web page (URL) in a new agent tab in Yab, the user's browser, signed in to their sites, beside the user's tabs (never in front of them: `show` puts one there when the user asked to see it). Waits for it to load and returns its id and an interactive snapshot. With urls, opens them all at once and returns each tab's id and title. With space, the tab is signed in where that space of the user's is (see `spaces`); without, where the user is signed in to the site, the space on screen first.

space.description: A space's name, as `spaces` lists it

name: open
title: Open Page
